Library Display Table

This was a unique project. I had the chance to collaborate with the Prince Rupert Library through the Oceanwise Conservation Association to help them build a display table for this whale skull. This piece began as a repurposed dresser and now will live in the library as a display piece. Oceanwise & the Prince Rupert Library Rocks!!!
